description: Overwrite a range (A1 notation, e.g. "Ledger!B2:C3") with values. Typed like sheets_append_rows; at most 10000 cells per call. Same approval rule as sheets_append_rows: free on a file Nooticr created or one the customer allowed you to edit, otherwise it waits for their approval. Use to change values that are already in a sheet.

appId.description: Product id; optional when the workspace has one product.

id.description: Spreadsheet id from sheets_create or sheets_list.

items.description: A number, boolean, text or an ISO date (2026-01-31) or datetime; null leaves the cell empty. Text that looks like a formula or number stays text; use {"formula": "=SUM(A1:A3)"} for a formula.

name: sheets_update_range
title: Update Spreadsheet Range
